== Biography ==

That entry labels his baptism 6 May at Whitburn, residence Blackburn; companion indexes instead label 26 April as baptism at Livingston. The original register has not been inspected. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1446|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Davidson-14073|Christine Davidson]].
